summary: The frozen post-IDAT compressed-metadata claim remains unresolved. The supplied handlers support decompression, but the effective build configuration and the harness path to png_read_end are not fully established.
missing_information: The effective before and after definitions of PNG_READ_zTXt_SUPPORTED, PNG_READ_iTXt_SUPPORTED, and PNG_READ_COMPRESSED_TEXT_SUPPORTED under the supplied build recipe.
The complete before and after bodies of png_read_end and png_set_interlace_handling.
The initial value of PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN in the read structure on both sides.

claims.necessity_reason: A post-IDAT zTXt handler can call png_decompress_chunk, but whether that handler is enabled and reached by this old harness is unresolved. The harness calls png_start_read_image after png_read_update_info; whether the intervening call preserves the row-init flag, and whether the resulting application error is fatal, are decisive.

before.requirement: For a supported PNG containing compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT, png_read_end must reach an accepting handler and decompress that metadata.
before.reason: png_read_info stops at IDAT, and the zTXt handler permits processing after IDAT and calls png_decompress_chunk. The effective configuration, png_read_end dispatch, and effect of the harness's intervening calls are not established.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: png_read_info leaves chunks after IDAT for later reading.
png_read_update_info initializes row reading before the harness's later png_start_read_image call.
A subsequent png_start_read_image call reports an application error if the row-init flag remains set.
The application error warns or terminates according to PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN.

after.requirement: For a supported PNG containing compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT, png_read_end must reach an accepting handler and decompress that metadata.
after.reason: The after-source zTXt handler still calls png_decompress_chunk for compressed text after IDAT. The same unresolved configuration and call-path facts prevent a definite assessment of the old harness.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: png_read_info still leaves chunks after IDAT for later reading.
png_read_update_info still initializes row reading before the later png_start_read_image call.
The later call still reports an application error if the row-init flag remains set.
The error's effect still depends on PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe fixes the build whose compressed-text options must be resolved.

claims.comparison_reason: Both sides have the same old harness call sequence and a zTXt-to-decompression path. A concrete blocker cannot be identified on either side until the configuration, png_read_end dispatch, intervening interlace call, and application-error default are known.
missing_information: Complete before and after png_read_end bodies to establish dispatch to post-IDAT zTXt or compressed iTXt handlers.
Complete before and after png_set_interlace_handling bodies to determine whether it changes PNG_FLAG_ROW_INIT between png_read_update_info and png_start_read_image.
Before and after read-structure initialization of PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN to determine whether the duplicate-call error terminates the read.
Effective compressed-text feature definitions from scripts/pnglibconf.dfa and configure.ac under the supplied recipe.
